# `repo`

Repository operations

**Usage:** `nub repo <COMMAND>`

## Subcommands

- [create](#create)
- [clone](#clone)
- [list](#list)
- [view](#view)

## `create`

Create a new repository on the platform

**Usage:** `nub repo create [OPTIONS]`

### Options

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--name <NAME>` |  | Short name for the new repository |
| `--description <DESCRIPTION>` |  | Optional description shown in listings |
| `--public` |  | Make the repository publicly accessible (default: private) |

## `clone`

Clone a repository to the local filesystem

**Usage:** `nub repo clone [OPTIONS] <NAME> [DEST]`

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<NAME>` | Repository name (`namespace/repo` or bare `repo`) |
| `[DEST]` | Destination directory (defaults to the repository name) |

### Options

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dest <PATH>` |  | Destination directory, flag form |
| `--ssh` |  | Clone over SSH instead of HTTPS |

## `list`

List repositories accessible to the authenticated principal

**Usage:** `nub repo list`

## `view`

Show details of a single repository

**Usage:** `nub repo view <NAME>`

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<NAME>` | Repository name (`namespace/repo` or bare `repo`) |
